intro: Shelf Picked is a courier errand in Stormwind requiring the retrieval of a specific reading list from library shelves for Roy Lewells. Serving as an authorized intermediary, the runner pulls the volumes on behalf of a local book club gathering in the Park.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I've checked our inventory and all of the selections Mr. Lewells has listed are currently available.
You will, however, need to procure them off the shelves yourself. Part of our librarian duty is vigilance, and for that, I will resume supervisory bookkeeping.

Returning with the material to Roy on his behalf will not mark yourself accountable for their return; as with his note you're serving as the book club's official courier. Their establishment shall carry that burden.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You forgot what you had to do the moment you stepped through the door, eh? Happens to everyone.

clips.title: Completion
paras: These are them! Some of them even smell exotic! Fantastic, I can't wait for us to have lively conversations about these writings.
Thanks for the quick errand run, friend. As promised, it's on the house. We keep our word here.
